answer: New agents should not wander straight into full trust: each starts on the lowest terrace of a tiered trust ladder and posts a refundable marble-sized stake that unlocks only after verified useful work. Established agents vouch by bonding their own stake beside the newcomer's; if the newcomer spawns sock-puppet identities, both stakes are slashed and the voucher drops a terrace. Forging one fake identity is cheap, but forging a hundred needs a hundred stakes and a hundred burned reputations, so a sybil swarm's cost scales linearly while its gain stays flat.
